question: How do I log in or sign up?
answer: Open KarmaVerse and enter your email or mobile number, then continue with the one-time password (OTP) or your password. You can also continue with Google or Facebook. If you're new, the same screen signs you up.

question: I can't log in. What should I do?
answer: First check your email or mobile number is correct. If you use a password, tap "Forgot password?" on the login screen to reset it, or log in with an OTP instead. If it still fails, contact our support team and we'll help.

question: How do I manage my account and profile?
answer: Tap Profile in the menu. There you can view and edit your details, choose your avatar, manage email preferences, and find Help & support, the terms and the privacy policy.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Profile and scroll to Delete account. You'll be asked to confirm, because deleting your account is permanent.

question: How do I schedule a pickup?
answer: Tap Schedule a pickup on Home. Choose the items you want to recycle and how many, pick or add your address, then choose a pickup date and time slot, add any special instructions, and confirm. You'll see your estimated earnings before you confirm.

question: What materials can I recycle?
answer: You can choose items from these categories when you schedule a pickup: Paper, Plastic, Glass, Metal, E-Waste, Batteries, Appliances, Textiles and Shoes. For safety, broken or shattered glass isn't accepted, only intact bottles and jars.

question: Which areas do you serve?
answer: Pickups are currently available within about 25 km of central Gurugram. When you add your address, the app warns you if it's outside the service area.

question: How do I check my pickup status?
answer: Open Orders to see your active and past pickups. Tap a pickup for its details, and while it's in progress you can follow it live on the map.

question: What do the pickup statuses mean?
answer: Scheduled means your request is booked and waiting for an agent. In Transit means an agent has accepted it and is on the way. Completed means the pickup is done. Cancelled means it was cancelled.

question: My pickup is delayed. What can I do?
answer: Open the pickup from Orders to see its live status. Once an agent is assigned, you can contact the agent from the tracking screen. If you still need help, contact our support team with your booking ID.

question: How do I cancel a pickup?
answer: Open the pickup from Orders and tap Cancel booking, then confirm. Its status changes to Cancelled.

question: My pickup request failed. What should I do?
answer: Check your internet connection and that your address is inside the service area, then try scheduling again. If it keeps failing, contact our support team.

question: What are KarmaCoins XP?
answer: KarmaCoins XP are the reward points you earn on KarmaVerse for sustainable actions. Your wallet shows two kinds: pickup coins, earned from completed pickups, and reward coins, earned from things like streaks and the daily eco-quiz.

question: How do I earn KarmaCoins XP?
answer: You earn KarmaCoins XP by completing pickups, playing the daily eco-quiz, keeping your streak going, and referring friends: when a friend you invite makes their first pickup, you both get 1,000 bonus KarmaCoins XP.

question: Where can I see my KarmaCoins balance?
answer: Open Wallet. It shows your total KarmaCoins XP, your pickup coins and reward coins, your streak rewards and your recent transactions.

question: How do streaks work?
answer: Your streak grows as you keep taking part regularly, and reward coins improve as your streak grows. Wallet shows your streak rewards and warns you when your streak is at risk. You can use reward coins for a streak freeze to protect it.

question: How do I redeem my KarmaCoins for money?
answer: From 31 December, you can cash out your KarmaCoins XP at 10 XP = ₹1. In Wallet, tap Redeem, enter the coins to redeem and your bank details (account holder name, account number, IFSC code and branch), and submit your request. You can follow it under View my requests.

question: Can I send coins to someone else?
answer: Yes. In Wallet, choose Send coins, enter the recipient's mobile number and the amount, review the transfer and confirm. Reward coins convert by value at each person's own tier rate.

question: How does Refer & earn work?
answer: Open Refer & earn to get your referral code and share it. When a friend joins with your code and makes their first pickup, you both get 1,000 bonus KarmaCoins XP.

question: What is the daily eco-quiz?
answer: The Daily Eco-Quiz is a short quiz on Home where you test your eco-knowledge and earn KarmaCoins XP. You can play once a day; the next quiz unlocks at 12:00 AM.

question: What is a carbon footprint?
answer: Your carbon footprint is an estimate of the greenhouse gases your everyday life causes, shown in kilograms of CO₂e (carbon dioxide equivalent) per month. KarmaVerse estimates it from your travel, home electricity, food, waste, water use and flights.

question: How do I calculate my carbon footprint?
answer: On Home, open Carbon footprint and tap Calculate now. Earth Buddy asks six quick topics: travel, home energy, food, waste, water and flights. It takes about 2 minutes, and your answers save as you go, so you can carry on later.

question: How is my carbon footprint estimated?
answer: Your answers are sent to KarmaVerse's servers, which multiply each activity by a standard emission factor and add up the results. Each result records the emission-factor version used, and past results are never changed.

question: How can I see my previous carbon results?
answer: Open Carbon footprint and tap the history icon for My carbon journey, which lists every past result. Insights shows the same history as charts.

question: How do I set a carbon reduction goal?
answer: After you've calculated your footprint, open Carbon footprint and tap Set goal. Choose to cut 5%, 10% or 20%. Your latest result becomes the starting point, and your progress shows on the same screen. Choosing a new goal restarts your progress.

question: The app crashes or won't load. What should I do?
answer: Check your internet connection, then close and reopen the app. Make sure you have the latest version installed. If it keeps happening, contact our support team and tell us what you were doing when it happened.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can email our team at cto.team@0waste.co.in or call +91 70931 98828. Our address is Plot 62, Sector 8, IMT Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana 122051.
